data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abr' meaning 'to bless'. In Islam, this name symbolizes blessings and good fortune, often given to a newborn girl. The name Mabrouka carries the meaning “Blessed, fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mabrouka usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mabrouka is closely related to blessings and Allah's goodness. In the Islamic faith, it is believed that all good things come from Allah, and the name serves as a constant reminder of the continual blessings that He bestows upon us. It also reflects the belief in the prophecy of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who said, "Name your child with a beautiful name. For, when Allah intends goodness for a person, He calls him by the being that He prefers for him." (Bukhari & Muslim)
